# Harte Auto Group — Sell or Trade Your Car

> Harte Auto Group buys and trades vehicles from Connecticut drivers. Get a real cash offer in about two minutes — free pickup, no obligation, 8-day price guarantee.

## What we do

- Instant online cash offers backed by Black Book market data
- Trade-in valuations toward any new or used vehicle in our inventory
- Service-lane trade-ups while your car is in for service
- Free vehicle pickup and on-the-spot payment across CT rooftops
